request.style: English, traditional gospel, powerful female lead vocal with gospel choir responses, Hammond organ, piano, bass, drums, slow swell to joyful release, 74 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Four days he lay in the Bethany tomb
The mourners wept in every room
Martha ran out to meet him on the road
Carrying a sorrow too heavy to hold

[Pre-Chorus]
Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died
Your brother will rise again

[Chorus]
I am the resurrection and the life
Whoever believes in me will live, even though he dies
Everyone who lives and believes in me will never die
Do you believe this?

[Verse]
He came up to the cave with the stone laid across
And Jesus wept beside them as they grieved for their loss
Then he lifted up his eyes and he thanked the Father there
And his voice like thunder went ringing through the air

[Bridge]
Lazarus, come out!
Unbind him and let him go
Yes, Lord. I believe that you are the Christ
The Son of God

[Chorus]
I am the resurrection and the life
Whoever believes in me will live, even though he dies
Everyone who lives and believes in me will never die
Do you believe this?

[Outro]
I am the resurrection and the life
Do you believe this?
Yes, Lord
